posts.text:
Google has outlined how it’s handling Donald Trump’s latest tantrum.

In the US, it will display “Lake America.”

In Canada, it will show “Lake Ontario.”

In the rest of the world, it will make it seem like a debate: “Lake Ontario (Lake America).”

More reason to replace Google Maps.
